summary:
Real-key / BYOK + Stripe e2e verification. All 10 backend tests passed (ALLOW_PLATFORM_KEY_FOR_DEV=false; GET /api/keys returns platform_dev=false for every provider on every seeded user; crab run as free with no keys -> 412 'Add your Google Gemini key in My Keys to run this.'; relay run as pro with no keys -> 412 'Squad crab Scout Sally (Scout) needs your Google Gemini key.'; all 5 providers reject fake-key-12345678 with their verbatim provider errors). /keys UI: key-input/save/test/delete and key-msg-

, key-status-

wire the real provider error text and last-test timestamp correctly (verified anthropic+gemini in UI; backend confirmed all 5 messages). Stripe test-mode end-to-end succeeded: upgrade-pro-btn -> Stripe sandbox -> card accordion -> 4242 4242 4242 4242, 12/34, 123, US/NY/10001, Subscribe -> /payment/success?session_id=cs_test_... -> payment-state 'Welcome to Pro', GET /api/payments/status/ payment_status=paid, GET /api/auth/me plan=pro, plan_until=2026-11-01. plan was reset back to 'free' with plan_until=null. Regression smoke /, /arena, /leaderboard, /hall render with 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: keys.py: dev_allowed() reads os.environ['ALLOW_PLATFORM_KEY_FOR_DEV'] on every request without caching and will KeyError if the env var is ever missing. Minor: cache or default to 'false'.
keys.py: validate() hard-codes provider URLs/headers inline; fine for now but a provider map constant at module scope would be cleaner and testable.
Keys.jsx (saw via UI): 'Save' button clearly works; consider disabling 'Test key' until a key is saved to avoid 404s when the field is empty.
Stripe Pricing.jsx: upgrade() swallows any non-string error; wrap in try/catch that stringifies network errors so pricing-error always shows something readable.
test_credentials: <redacted-email> / <redacted-password> (reset to plan=free), <redacted-email> / <redacted-password>, <redacted-email> / <redacted-password>. Stripe test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 12/34 CVC 123.
seed_data_creation: None. Any fake keys saved during tests were deleted; free user's plan was reset to 'free'/plan_until=null in Mongo after Stripe test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ALLOW_PLATFORM_KEY_FOR_DEV=false is live. Backend /api/keys/<provider>/test is rate-limited to 10/min/user — if you run backend tests first, UI /keys 'Test key' clicks will 429 for ~60s; wait between runs. Stripe sandbox requires Billing Address line 1 + City + Phone to pass; use #billingAddressLine1, #billingLocality, #billingPostalCode, #phoneNumber. Card accordion button data-testid='card-accordion-item-button' must be clicked via JS .click() (Playwright treats its clickable rect as outside viewport even when visible).
rca of the issue: N/A — nothing broken. All real-key enforcement + Stripe test-mode flows passed on the first clean run.
